name: silk
enchant_note: Silk takes a charm well, as the old embroiderers knew.
protection_note: Silk does not part under an arrowhead: it wraps the point and draws out clean, which is why the Mongol riders wore it under their coats.
protection_price: Catches fire, and fire scorches it.
lore_descriptor: pale gold and slick as river water under the hand
first_pickup_chronicle: Mongol silk undershirt. An arrow caught in it draws out clean.
